description: This Java class implements a map entry (key-value pair) for a custom 'GenericMap' structure, providing methods to access and modify entries, as well as standard equality and hash code functions.

classes.name: GenericMapEntry
classes.description: A map entry implementation for a generic map, providing key-value access and modification.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with this entry.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the key, retrieving it from the parent map.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for the key in the parent map.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this entry and another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code for this map entry.
